{{Quote|I simply cannot understand how ''Master Anakin'' could ever ''hurt'' her. You ''remember'' the wedding, don't you Artoo?''"<br />"''Vooweep!''"<br />"''They seemed like such perfect counterparts.|C-3PO and R2-D2, shortly after Padmé Amidala's death|<ref name="MemoryLoss">{{SWComicCite|7.13|Memory Loss}}</ref>}}
The '''wedding''' of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] took place at the [[Varykino Villa/Legends|Varykino Villa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The two first met [[32 BBY/Legends|ten years prior]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], at the time Skywalker had been an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] nine-year-old and Amidala was fourteen-years-old and serving as the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] of Naboo. Having escaped the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Amidala was disguised as one of the queen's [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]].

==Prelude==
===Fateful meeting (32 BBY)===
====Tatooine====
{{Quote|I'm going to marry you,''"<br />[laughs]<br />"''I mean it.''"<br />"''You are an odd one, why do you say that?''"<br />"''I guess because it's what I believe&hellip;''"<br />"''Well I'm afraid I can't marry you&hellip; ''[forgetting his name]"<br />"''Anakin.''"<br />"''Anakin. You're just a little boy.''"<br />"''I won't always be.|Anakin Skywalker predicts his marriage to Padmé Amidala on their first meeting|<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:Anakin_Meets_Padme.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The first meeting of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala]]
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a nine-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the fourteen-year-old [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]], first met on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> in the year [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> Amidala had [[Capture of Theed/Legends|escaped]] her [[Naboo/Legends|homeworld]] after it was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and was forced to land on Tatooine to repair her [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|starship's]] [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|hyperdrive generator]]. While masquerading as one of her [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] under the name of Padmé Naberrie, along with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], Naberrie arrived in [[Wald's Parts|Watto's junkshop]] to purchase a hyperdrive, where Skywalker was enslaved.<ref name="TPM" />

While Jinn negotiated with [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], Skywalker asked Naberrie if she was an [[Diathim/Legends|Angel]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] considered the most beautiful in the [[Universe/Legends|known Universe]].<ref name="TPM" /> Naberrie was confused but pleased<ref name="Journal">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref> and continued to converse with Skywalker while he discussed his aspiration of becoming a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="TPM" /> She felt an immediate connection with the boy, as though she had known him all her life.<ref name="TPM jr">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' junior novelization]]</ref> After they both laughed at Binks' clumsy attempt to deal with a [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|pit droid]] he had activated, Skywalker looked at Naberrie and stated that he would marry her. She laughed off his claim, given his age, but Skywalker insisted that he would not always be a child.<ref name="TPM novel" /> 

[[File:Blood_sample.png|thumb|left|300px|Qui-Gon Jinn (left) believed that Anakin Skywalker was the Chosen One, which changed the child's destiny.]]
Skywalker was eager to spend more time with Naberrie,<ref name="TPM novel" /> inviting her and her companions into his home, where he introduced Naberrie to a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] he had been building: [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. Jinn had been unable to pay Watto for the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] in a currency he would accept, but Skywalker offered to win the upcoming [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] and use the prize winnings to pay for the hyperdrive. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] made a wager with Watto that would secure Skywalker's freedom if he won the race, but not that of his [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]]. He had confirmed a high level of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] in Skywalker and hoped to train him as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], believing he was the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] destined to bring balance to [[The Force/Legends|The Force]].<ref name="TPM" /> Following the toss of the [[Chance cube/Legends|chance cube]] for the wager, Naberrie discussed the cruelty of slavery with Skywalker and promised that she would do what she could to get the Republic to end slavery. Skywalker commented that leaving Tatooine as a free man would make things much easier for him when they got married.<ref name="Episode I: Queen Amidala">''[[Episode I: Queen Amidala]]''</ref>

====Coruscant====
{{Quote|It's beautiful. But I don't need this to remember you. How could I forget my future husband?|Padmé's response to Anakin's gift of a japor snippet|<ref name="TPM novel" />}}
[[File:Anakin_and_Padme_starship.png|thumb|right|350px|While travelling to Coruscant, Skywalker gave Naberrie a japor snippet that he had carved for her.]]
Skywalker indeed won the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|podrace]] and received his freedom.<ref name="TPM" /> While still on Tatooine, Jinn alluded to Naberrie that he believed Skywalker won because his interest in her had given him a reason to succeed.<ref name="Episode I: Qui-Gon Jinn">''[[Episode I: Qui-Gon Jinn]]''</ref> The boy joined Jinn and Naberrie on their repaired [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on its journey to the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where they intended to share news of the Invasion of Naboo to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. En route, Naberrie found Skywalker sitting sadly alone, missing his mother. He presented her with a [[Japor snippet/Legends|japor snippet]] he had carved so that she would remember him.<ref name="TPM" /> Naberrie joked that she would not need to remember him, as she could never forget her future husband. She then comforted and embraced him as he expressed sadness for his separation from his mother. When they reached Coruscant, Skywalker found himself exchanging quick glances and smiles with Naberrie that made him blush. He also continued trying to find Naberrie while she dealt with political matters and attempted to resolve the invasion, although he could not identify her amongst her handmaidens as she was acting in her true role as Queen Amidala.<ref name="TPM novel" /> Throughout the journey, Amidala told Skywalker stories from her own childhood.<ref name="AOTC novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> 

Later, Skywalker learned that Jinn intended to present him to [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] as a candidate to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a Jedi. He attempted to find Naberrie to tell her<ref name="TPM novel" /> and to say goodbye,<ref name="Journal" /> but was disappointed when he only found Queen Amidala in one of Naboo [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] apartments,<ref name="TPM novel" /> in the building [[500 Republica/Legends|''500 Republica'']]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> unaware that her and Padmé Naberrie were the same person. Amidala maintained the deception by claiming that Naberrie had been sent on an errand. Skywalker was excited and believed that Naberrie would be impressed, and so Amidala claimed she would pass on his news to Naberrie after observing his initial disappointment.<ref name="TPM novel" /> Amidala wished that she could have given Skywalker a warmer farewell, but needed to maintain the illusion that her and Padmé were different people. She later recorded in her journal that she was surprised at how important the boy had become to her.<ref name="Journal" />

====End of the invasion====
{{Quote|I guess knowing I'm a Queen makes you feel differently about me, doesn't it?''"<br />"''I guess, but that's okay. Just so you still like me. Because I still like you.''"<br />"''Of course, Annie. Telling you who I really am doesn't mean my feelings for you have changed. I was the same person before, whether you knew the truth about me or not.|Amidala and Skywalker, after the former revealed that she was really the Queen of Naboo|<ref name="TPM novel" />}}
The Council objected to Skywalker's training, in spite of Jinn's determination. Amidala also resolved to return to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|liberate]] Naboo, and was joined by Binks, Jinn, his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and Skywalker.<ref name="TPM" /> As they waited for Binks to contact the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]], Naberrie spoke to Skywalker for what he believed was the first time since Tatooine. She asked how he was and he described his disappointment at being rejected for Jedi training, in response she told him not to give up hope.<ref name="TPM novel" /> In a successful attempt to gain the loyalty of the Gungans, Naberrie revealed herself as the true queen.<ref name="TPM" /> Skywalker was shocked, and remembering his promise of marriage to Amidala, wondered how a former slave could possibly marry a queen. He hoped to discuss it with her, but would not have the chance until they marched towards [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="TPM novel" />

Amidala approached Skywalker and apologized that she could not reveal her identity. She asked if he felt differently in that light, and Skywalker assured her that he still liked her and hoped she reciprocated. Amidala assured him that she was still the same person and that her feelings were unchanged. This led Skywalker to promise to himself that he would do what he could to protect her and Jinn during the battle.<ref name="TPM novel" /> Amidala found herself concerned about Skywalker and believing that she could not forgive herself if anything bad happened to him. As the battle to retake Theed began inside [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]], Amidala lost sight of Skywalker and hoped he had listened to Jinn's instructions and found shelter.<ref name="TPM jr" />

[[File:Naboo_celebration.jpg|thumb|left|350px|The Freedom Day parade (pictured) marked the last time that Skywalker and Amidala would see each other for a decade.]]
Instead, Skywalker was busy fulfilling his personal promise, commandeering an [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] to destroy several [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] inside the hangar, before unintentionally flying into space and destroying the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']].<ref name="TPM novel" /> That resulted in the deactivation of all the Trade Federation [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on Naboo and secured the planet's freedom. However, Jinn was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle, and Kenobi was tasked by the Council to fulfill his master's determination to train Skywalker as a Jedi.<ref name="TPM" /> Amidala barely spoke to Skywalker after his acceptance,<ref name="TPM novel" /> aside from a brief conversation prior to the [[Freedom Day]] parade held to mark the end of the invasion. Skywalker promised that he would see Amidala again, and she agreed, stating her belief that their fates were bound together.<ref name="Journal" /> During the celebration, the two exchanged smiles with each other.<ref name="TPM" />

===Intervening years (32 BBY&ndash;22 BBY)===
{{Quote|I've thought about her every day since we parted&hellip;|Anakin Skywalker to Jar Jar Binks after his awkward reunion with Amidala|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
Skywalker thought of Amidala [[Standard day/Legends|daily]] during the subsequent [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]].<ref name="AOTC" /> He found that he could still recall the scent of her [[Hair/Legends|hair]], the passion in her [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and the sound of her voice.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]],<ref name="Readers Rogue">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Rogue Planet]]'' in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].</ref> after performing a set of daily exercises during a mission to the planet [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]], Skywalker experienced a period of mental clarity in which he imagined what his future held. He imagined marrying a woman like Amidala, with a powerful and dignified presence alongside a sadness that Skywalker could help alieviate,<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref> although marriage was not permitted for Jedi.<ref name="AOTC" />

===Forbidden love (22 BBY)===
====Assassination attempt on Amidala====
=====Reunion=====
{{Quote|Annie? My goodness you've grown.''"<br />"''So have you&hellip; grown more beautiful I mean.|Amidala and Skywalker's first conversation in a decade|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:Anakin_Padme_Reunite.png|thumb|right|350px|(left to right) Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Padmé Amidala reunite in the latter's apartment.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Amidala, now the senator for Naboo, returned to Coruscant to vote against the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Skywalker heard news of her return through comm chatter, and arranged to jump out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] early while returning to the planet. Kenobi scolded his apprentice for doing so amidst Coruscant's congested approach lanes, but Skywalker quietly believed the chance to see Amidala again was worth the consequences, even if his actions only meant they arrived a few [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] early.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> Amidala's [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|cruiser]] was [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|destroyed]] upon landing by a bomb planted by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], acting secretly on the orders of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], head of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|separatist movement]] against the Republic. Amidala survived the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt, leading Palpatine, now the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], to suggest that she be placed under Jedi protection, specifically that of Amidala's old friends Kenobi and Skywalker.<ref name="AOTC" />

Skywalker was nervous as he and his master headed for [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|Amidala's apartment]], with Kenobi [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] his Padawan's anxiety and urging him to relax as they rode the building's elevator. Skywalker reminded his master that he had not seen Amidala in ten years,<ref name="AOTC" /> to which Kenobi replied that she was not a queen anymore, and Skywalker muttered that he was not nervous for that reason. Upon entering the apartment, Skywalker found it difficult not to rush in to greet Amidala, and was delighted to find that she was as beautiful as he remembered. He then found it took all of his willpower to even approach Amidala.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> When the two Jedi greeted Amidala, she commented on how quickly he had grown, which Skywalker reciprocated by responding that she had grown more beautiful. She then stated that he would always be the child she met on Tatooine, hurting Skywalker's pride.<ref name="AOTC" />

=====Jedi guardian=====
{{Quote|Anakin, escort the Senator back to her home planet of Naboo, she'll be safer there. And don't use registered transport. Travel as refugees.|Mace Windu's orders to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:AnakinSavesPadme-AOTC1.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Zam Wesell's second assassination attempt (pictured) on Amidala prompted Skywalker to be assigned to protect her own his own.]]
As the Jedi discussed Amidala's security arrangements, the senator stated her belief that the priority was identifying her attackers. Skywalker agreed and promised to investigate, leading to a rebuff from Kenobi about the nature of their mission. After Amidala retired to her bedroom, Binks, now a [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]], expressed his delight at seeing Skywalker again, which prompted him to show his disappointment at what he perceived as Amidala's lack of recognition for him.<ref name="AOTC" /> While brushing her heir, Amidala pondered Skywalker's compliment. She was used to drawing male gazes with her appearance, and wondered if Skywalker had been looking at her with a sense of longing. This led her to cover the security cameras in her bedroom in case Skywalker was watching,<ref name="AOTC novel" /> which he had been doing.<ref name="AOTC" />

Later that evening, Skywalker used the chime to enter Amidala's room. Amidala was in her nightwear at the time, and before answering, she realized her attire was somewhat revealing and retrieved her nightrobe, aware that she would not normally make such considerations. The two discussed the nature of the Jedi's mission and the possibility of finding Amidala's would-be assassins.<ref name="AOTC" /> Later in the night, Skywalker continued to watch Amidala with his senses and wished he could kiss her, settling for feeling her sensations through the Force. Likewise, Amidala dreamt of Skywalker thwarting an assassination attempt on her in the Senate floor.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> Wesell made another assassination attempt using venemous [[Kouhun/Legends|Kouhuns]], although Skywalker sensed the disturbance and killed the creatures. The Jedi tracked down Wesell, who was discreetly murdered by her associate [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] before she could reveal who had hired her. The attempt prompted the Jedi Council to arrange for Amidala to return to Naboo under Skywalker's independent protection, his first solo assignment as a Jedi, while Kenobi investigated.<ref name="AOTC" />

====Alone on Naboo====
=====Passage to Naboo=====
{{Quote|Are you allowed to love? I thought it was forbidden for a Jedi.''"<br />"''Attachment is forbidden. Possession is forbidden. Compassion, which I would define as unconditional love, is central to a Jedi's life, so you might say we're encouraged to love.|Padmé Amidala and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:Anakin_and_Padme_refugees.png|thumb|right|300px|Skywalker's mission to return Amidala to Naboo allowed both of them to spend quality time together.]]
Skywalker was present in Amidala's apartment as she packed her belongings.<ref name="AOTC" /> In the course of their conversation, Amidala commented on Skywalker's growing maturity, leading to an extended moment where they locked eyes, as though they could see each others hearts.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> Amidala told him not to grow up too quickly, and asked Skywalker to spare her the discomfort of looking at her that way.<ref name="AOTC" /> He apologized, knowing that he could not simply assume the role of Amidala's bodyguard against her wishes.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> To arrive safely on Naboo, Skywalker and Amidala were disguised as outland [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], accompanied by R2-D2, who had remained in Amidala's service since the Invasion of Naboo.<ref name="AOTC" /> Kenobi was initially concerned about Skywalker's enthusiasm for the mission, but became preoccupied with identifying the senator's assassins.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

As they travelled aboard an [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|AA-9 Coruscant freighter]], the [[Jendirian Valley/Legends|''Jendirian Valley'']], Amidala found herself admiring a sleeping Skywalker, whom she also found handsome, for the indications of rebellion against his Jedi training she had observed in their interactions. After waking Skywalker up for a meal,<ref name="AOTC novel" /> she asked him how difficult it must be for Jedi to live a life of restraint in their actions. Skywalker noted that amongst his prohibitions was the chance to be with the people he loved, to which Amidala asked if he was even allowed to love others, given the Jedi rules against marriage. The Padawan stated that he was encouraged to be compassionate and in a way, encouraged to love.<ref name="AOTC" /> The conversation led Amidala to realize that her and Skywalker were too close, and a romance between them would have significant implications for her political work. She reasoned that her opposition to the Military Creation Act would create friction if the vote passed, as the Jedi would be required to fight alongside the Republic military.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

=====Meet the parents=====
{{Quote|Did you know, Anakin, that you're the first boyfriend my sister's ever brought home?''"<br />"''He's not my boyfriend. Anakin's a friend, we've known each other for years. He's a Jedi assigned by the Senate to protect me.|Sola Naberrie and Padmé Amidala during dinner at the Naberrie house|<ref name="AOTC deleted scene">{{Film|II}} deleted scene</ref>}}
[[File:Naboo_Throne_Room.png|thumb|left|350px|Amidala and Skywalker met with Queen Jamillia together on Naboo.]]
As they arrived in Theed, the two discussed Amidala's political career and time as queen. The senator was surprised at how open she became around Skywalker when she admitted that she longed to have a family of her own.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> The two met with Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] and [[Governor of Naboo/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] to discuss the Separatist Crisis and the arrangements for Amidala's safety. The senator suggested that she would stay in Naboo's [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]], which Skywalker protested on account of being head of security.<ref name="AOTC" /> Amidala was about to argue back when she realized that Bibble and Jamillia had exchanged suspicious looks, meaning that she could not engage in arguments with Skywalker publicly without drawing attention to the nature of their relationship. She calmly explained that her knowledge of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] would be advantageous, to which Bibble agreed with amusement. At Jamillia's suggestion, Amidala also agreed that it would be a good idea to visit her family and ease their concerns for her safety.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

As the two made their way to Amidala's childhood home, Skywalker found himself trying to steal looks at Amidala that he could burn into his memory. As she was wearing a simple blue dress, Skywalker mentally compared it to the ornate garbs she had worn as queen, and rationalized that although she looked beautiful in anything, he preferred the more simple appearances that allowed her to show more of her real self. Outside the Naberrie house, the travellers were first greeted by Amidala's nieces, [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo]] and [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], followed by their mother [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola]]. Skywalker recognized that Amidala had been pained by the throught of the anxiety the news of the assassination attempts on her would have been causing her family, and that he loved that empathetic side of her. Next, they headed inside and Skywalker met Amidala's parents, [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee]] and [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal Naberrie]], just as the family was preparing to have dinner.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

=====Sisterly advice=====
{{Quote|What are you afraid of, Sis? Are you afraid of Anakin's feelings and the responsibilities that he cannot dismiss? Or are you afraid of your own feelings? I don't know how you feel, but I suspect that it's something new to you. Something scary, but something wonderful.|Sola Naberrie, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="AOTC novel" />}}
[[File:Padmes_Parents_House.png|thumb|right|350px|Skywalker and Amidala had dinner with the latter's family.]]
During the meal, Sola playfully asked Skywalker if he was aware that he was the first boy Amidala had ever brought home. Amidala was quick to rebuff the claim that Skywalker was anything other than her bodyguard assigned by the Senate, which caused Jobal to panic in realizing the seriousness of the attempts on her daughter's life. Skywalker noticed throughout the dinner that Sola was constantly staring at him, seemingly trying to scrutinize him while also smiling as if she knew a secret. Later, Skywalker walked through the house's gardens with Ruwee, and he felt glad to recognize a level of respect in Ruwee's eyes, as his relationship with Amidala would have been impacted if either of her parents had visibly disliked him.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

Concurrently, Amidala, Jobal, and Sola cleaned up after dinner, and the latter began asking her sister why she had not mentioned Skywalker before. Amidala tried to shut down the conversation by claiming the Padawan was "just a boy," but Sola tried to address Skywalker's palpable feelings for the Senator and questioned if Amidala had noticed the way he looked at her. Amidala denied any romantic notions, stating that their relationship was purely professional. Sola responded by wondering aloud if Amidala was afraid to acknowledge the way Skywalker looked at her, exasperating Amidala to the point that she asked her mother to intervene. Later, Amidala asked her sister why she had repeatedly made comments about Skywalker, and Sola responded that his feelings were too obvious to ignore. Sola commented that Jedi were not supposed to consider romantic attachments, but that Skywalker clearly did, and that Amidala was thinking too much like a Jedi, letting her life be dominated by duties without considering a personal life.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

[[File:PadmesRoomNaboo-AotC.png|thumb|left|300px|Skywalker and Amidala in the latter's room on Naboo]]
Sola continued trying to get her sister to contemplate having a relationship alongside her senatorial role, noting the contrasting attitudes she perceived between the young pair; Amidala acted as though she was prohibited from attachments, and Skywalker acted as though he was uninhibited. Amidala chastised her sister for making such a leap in logic, as her and Skywalker had only been together for a handful of days after a decade-long separation. Sola stated that she had no knowledge of how Amidala herself felt, but that she could tell how Skywalker felt and that Amidala could see it too. As the sisters hugged, Sola asked what Amidala was afraid of, speculating that she was truly unsure how to handle her novel situation. Later that day, the two packed their belongings as they prepared to depart to the [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] estate. They discussed two different [[holograph]]s that displayed Amidala's past work. One showed her time working with the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]], happily embracing [[N'a-kee-tula]], a [[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]] child who would later perish along with the rest of his species. Another holograph showed Amidala several years later, dressed in formal robes on her first day as an [[Apprentice Legislator/Legends|Apprentice Legislator]]. Skywalker found himself gazing at the holographs, contemplating how they showed two distinct sides of the woman he loved.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

=====Lakeside=====
{{Quote|I don't like sand. It's course and rough and irritating, and it gets everywhere. Not like here. Here, everything's soft and smooth.|Anakin Skywalker, just before his first kiss with Padmé Amidala|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:First_kiss.png|thumb|right|300px|Skywalker and Amidala kissed for the first time on Naboo.]]
Skywalker and Amidala travelled to Varykino via a speedboat helmed by [[Paddy Accu/Legends|Paddy Accu]], an experienced sailor who gave the two an enjoyable ride as he had done in Amidala's youth.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> The natural beauty of the [[Water/Legends|lake]] country seemed to generate romantic feelings in both Skywalker and Amidala.<ref name="Fact file 49">{{FactFile|49|NAB 21-22|Naboo &ndash; Varykino Lakeside Retreat}}</ref> The two walked up the stairs onto a balcony looking out [[Unidentified Naboo lake|the lake]], and Amidala reminisced about her youth in which she and her friends would swim to an [[Unidentified Naboo island|island]] during their school retreat, along with lying on the sand. Skywalker responded about his own hatred of sand for its texture and tendency to permeate, at which point he began stroking Amidala's arm,<ref name="AOTC" /> almost without realizing it.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> He contrasted sand with his own impression of Naboo, calling it soft and smooth.<ref name="AOTC" /> Skywalker nearly pulled himself back, although aware that Amidala seemed nervous, she had not pulled away from his touch. After Amidala talked about a [[Unidentified glass artisan|talented glass artisan]] who lived on the island,<ref name="AOTC novel" /> Skywalker leant in for a long kiss. Amidala engaged initially, and Skywalker felt that he could be lost forever in that moment until Amidala pulled herself away and stated that she should not have returned Skywalker's affection.<ref name="AOTC" /> Skywalker apologized and the two moved on, silently looking out at the water.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

Later, the two sat down in a meadow surrounded by waterfalls.<ref name="AOTC" /> Amidala enjoyed watching Skywalker's reaction to the pleasant surroundings on Naboo, stealing quick glances at him while hoping he would not notice her.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

==The wedding==
{{Quote|Anakin, Padmé was my Queen; I was her ambassador to the Senate. Naboo is my ''home''. You of all people know how I value loyalty and friendship; do you think I have no friends among the civil clergy in Theed? Your secret ceremony has never ''been'' a secret. Not from me, at any rate. I have always been very happy for you both.|Palpatine, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Episode III novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:Wedding_of_Anakin_and_Padme.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker and Amidala on Naboo]]
Skywalker and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] escaped from [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] with their lives, after being rescued by a [[Jedi strike team]] and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The rescue led to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], sparking the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. After the battle, Skywalker returned with Amidala to Naboo under the pretense that he was escorting her back home, as the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] was unaware that the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] had fallen in love with the [[Senator/Legends|senator]]. In reality, the two star-crossed lovers were married<ref name="AOTC" /> at [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]], a lake retreat in [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]] on Naboo.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The union was witnessed by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The marriage remained a secret, as Skywalker could have been expelled from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] if the union was discovered by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The secret marriage of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]; the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novel]] depicted it slightly before the film's release in [[2002]]. However, that Anakin Skywalker would be married in the second installment of the [[prequel trilogy]] was announced in [[1998]]. The [[original trilogy]] was [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|re-released in theaters and VHS]] to commemorate the twenty year anniversary of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] [[1997|the year before]] and [[Star Wars Trivial Pursuit]] was released to coincide with this. The limited edition game contained a sequestered pack of questions that served as a preview of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|the first new trilogy installment]], one of which divulged this.
